scope: R13-C five whole-body static contracts; dependencies are selected context only. No behavioral or complete training-system validation.
address_space: PE32 virtual addresses; structure offsets are hexadecimal byte offsets

evidence.method: Pinned original PE decoded with Capstone 5.0.7; all 283 owned instructions agree with independently supplied read-only native exports. No original execution.

shared_index.accepted: signed checks admit exactly i=0..15 after 32-bit wrapping
shared_index.unknown: Global and key identity meanings; time stability and producers

functions.role: Copy input into indexed 54-byte block, then invoke mutable update boundary
functions.abi: ECX manager; two four-byte stack slots (key pointer, input pointer); RET 8; semantic return value not established
preconditions: Key readable through byte +0x3c on success

flow.effect: Preserve receiver in EBX and key in EBP; call 008b4cd0(receiver,key)
Copy 13 dwords and one word from input to returned interior pointer, forward with ambient DF
Call 008b2880 with original ECX receiver and stack arguments (read32(key+0x39),key)

functions.failure: Null locator result adds diagnostic 0x31a and clears global 00b67a34 after diagnostic helpers return; no copy/update
functions.limitation: 008b2880 can mutate copied subrows; final bytes and complete transitive effects/RNG are unresolved
functions.confidence: high for direct contract; dependency semantics incomplete

functions.abi: ECX manager; two four-byte stack slots (key pointer, output pointer); RET 8; semantic return value not established

flow.effect: Call 008b4cd0 with same incoming receiver and key, branch on EAX
Copy 13 dwords plus one word from located block to output; no update call

functions.failure: Null locator result adds diagnostic 0x604 and clears global 00b67a34 after diagnostic helpers return; output not copied
functions.limitation: Snapshot persistence and caller buffer ownership/lifetime are unresolved
functions.confidence: high for direct static copy contract

functions.role: Return interior 155-byte record selected by relative ID and signed byte selector
functions.abi: ECX manager; two four-byte stack slots (key pointer, selector with only low signed byte used); EAX pointer or explicit zero; RET 8
preconditions: Key is dereferenced without null guard
Manager must back the selected record

flow.effect: Compute shared index; reject negative or signed >=16
Use selector j=0..9; signed negatives or >=10 become 1

functions.failure: Invalid index diagnoses 0x68f, clears global 00b67a34 if helpers return, and explicitly returns EAX=0
functions.limitation: Selector values and first seven preceding record meanings are unresolved
functions.confidence: high for formula, signed width and alias contract

functions.role: Allocate and default indexed six-byte rows
functions.abi: ECX manager; no stack arguments; plain RET; semantic return value not established
preconditions: Source dword IDs valid within allocated row count
Allocation count*6 must not overflow the admitted domain
Existing +0x651d pointer is not released here

flow.effect: Call 00945501(count,6); publish EAX, including null, to manager+0x651d before testing
Iterate signed positive count; reload count each loop; source stride 0x46
Use unchecked source dword ID to address allocation+6*ID; byte +5 &= 0xdf

functions.failure: Null allocation diagnoses 0x6e3 and clears global 00b67a34 if helpers return; manager+0x651d remains null
functions.limitation: Default constructor branch/nearby release support ownership; full lifecycle, repeat safety and data-ID validity are unproven
functions.confidence: high for direct allocation/writes; moderate for lifecycle role

functions.abi: ECX manager; one four-byte stack slot (key pointer); EAX pointer or explicit zero; RET 4

flow.effect: Compute shared index; reject negative or signed >=16

functions.failure: Null key diagnoses 0xa20; invalid index diagnoses 0xa2a; each clears global 00b67a34 if helpers return, explicitly returning EAX=0
functions.limitation: Returned storage lifetime follows manager and shared-index state; no stable ownership or persistent meaning established
functions.confidence: high for formula, validation and alias contract

layout.evidence: 008b0ee9/0eee/0ef8 supplies 167 entries of 155 bytes; exactly ends at +0x651d; accessor returns indices 7..166
layout.confidence: high static region extent; element meaning incomplete
high pointer field; moderate full ownership

layout.evidence: 16*54-byte relative-ID blocks; 008b1016..1034 initializes 96 stride-nine subrows as dword(-1),dword(0),byte(0)

dependency_boundaries.evidence: 008b28f4 uses 54-byte locator; six stride-nine subrows; resets and per-byte writes at 008b293d..2945/2b89
dependency_boundaries.limit: Full update, transitive helpers and RNG open

dependency_boundaries.evidence: 008b1006/100d optional loader result bypass; otherwise 008b1011 initializer plus inline defaults
dependency_boundaries.limit: Full constructor failure and loader effects open

dependency_boundaries.evidence: Release +0x651d at 008b107e, clear at 008b1086; release helper can call HeapFree
dependency_boundaries.limit: Destructor reachability and all lifetime paths open

dependency_boundaries.evidence: 32-bit argument product; successful paths use HeapAlloc flags 8 or zero-fill helper 0094a640
dependency_boundaries.limit: Allocator internals and overflow/zero-size behavior are not behavioral validation

diagnostics.limit: Helpers may have external effects; their return/termination behavior is not fully traced. Copy wrappers can diagnose twice through locator and own failure paths.

validation_limits: Whole-body static contracts only; no original-instruction execution fixture or training outcome oracle
Successful owned locators, copy-out and initializer have no direct RNG call; transitive RNG purity not established
Partial manager layout, no proposed native type/prototype replacement
Source path and provisional names are not independent semantic proof
